title: Yuminy Mellow Meditterane Kanten-Pilaf
description: A light and show-off Mediterranean dish featuring kanten-agar, prepared with a leaf-wrap steam method for an egg-free-friendly option.

ingredients.name: Pinch of cayenne pepper (optional for heat)

instructions: Mix kanten agar, lemon juice, and salt in a bowl.
Fold in minced garlic, chopped parsley, mint, and olive oil. Stir well until all ingredients are combined evenly.
Sprinkle cayenne pepper over the mixture if desired for an extra kick of heat.
Wrap the mixture in cheesecloth or a clean kitchen towel to steam.
Steam wrapped mixture for 20 minutes at medium-low heat.
Unwrap the cooked kanten and allow it to cool before serving.
